challenge.better_approach: A read-fold of the flat root beside the holder address would avoid a migration but leaves the drift standing forever; a block-name-to-holder lookup inside write_trace would spare the callers but makes the machine know its consumers. Callers naming their holder is the smallest honest shape.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the holder of each shared-tool block is as mapped: the outline names the librarian, CodeMother and the web server as holders, skill_block as CC's for now (16.3.3) and the compiler's user as Cairn (17.12); logger_for_bash -> cairn/0 is inferred from bin being Cairn's own. And that a long-running device still on old code will write the flat file again until it restarts, which migrate (idempotent) clears.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/base/address.py (instance_path, and its docstring naming this very address as drift); legacy_trace_path in learning_block.py is the precedent for folding an old name; outline 16.4.3 web_operator is the pattern.
challenge.real_collision: none found: read the learning_block and skill_block charters in the congruency lab and address.py; outline 16.4.3 is the rule this implements

answers.falsifier: (1) under a scratch HOME, write_trace('b', ..., holder='librarian/0') lands at <HOME>/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/machines/learning_block/traces/b.jsonl, read_trace, trace_lines and dial with the same holder read it back, and nothing is created under <HOME>/.cairn/devices/learning_block; (2) write_trace, read_trace, trace_lines, dial, fire_door, traced and run_block called with neither holder nor root raise TraceRefused naming holder and write nothing; the shell door's trace and dial without --holder exit 2; (3) no class-space source outside cairn/machines/learning_block/ (proofs, validations and history excluded) spells devices/learning_block, and every shell-door call in cairn/devices/cc/superclaude and bin/logger_for_bash passes --holder; (4) migrate over a scratch flat root moves each BLOCK_HOLDERS block's lines into its holder's file, appended to lines already there with no line twice, removes the flat file, and leaves an unmapped block's file in place, naming it; a second migrate moves nothing; (5) cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py and cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/ stay green over the change
answers.from_idea: none, because open-d5cfd943a2ab (CairnCommons/questions/) records the drift and the orchestrator's message of 2026-11-13 asked for this cast
answers.how: D1: learning_block.py: trace_root(holder) parses '<device>/<n>' and returns instance_path(device, n)/machines/learning_block/traces (CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT still overrides, flat, for proofs); trace_path, trace_lines, write_trace, traced, read_trace, fire_door and dial take holder=, and with neither holder nor root raise TraceRefused naming holder; trace_roots() lists every holder's trace dir; BLOCK_HOLDERS maps the flat files to holders. D2: engine.run_block passes holder= through. D3: the shell door takes --holder <device>/<n> on trace and dial (refused without), and a migrate verb moves each mapped flat file into its holder's file (appending, no line twice), removes the flat file, and leaves and names any unmapped one. D4: skill_block.SKILL_HOLDER='cc/0' rides fire and skilldial; the skill doors and refusal probes name it. D5: each device writer names itself (librarian, codemother clearance, web_server), the compiler cairn/0, superclaude cc/0, logger_for_bash cairn/0; tellmeabout and the corpus probe walk trace_roots(). D6: the proof. Holders: librarian-ask -> librarian/0 (8.5); harbor_master__clearance -> codemother/0 (9.4.1.4); web_server -> web_server/0 (15.4); intentions_model_compiler -> cairn/0 (17.12, its user is Cairn); logger_for_bash -> cairn/0 (bin is Cairn's own); superclaude -> cc/0 (10.3.2); every skill:*, skill__*, sail:* and fable:* block -> cc/0 (16.3.3, skill_block is CC's for now).
answers.traces_to: Law 6 (a held machine's state is the holder's to own and gate, berthed under the holder that assembled it) and Law 1 (one address resolver, not the flat path spelled again in two probes).
answers.what: Each learning_block trace is written and read at its holder's address, ~/.cairn/devices/<holder>/<n>/machines/learning_block/traces/, never at a top-level learning_block device, and the traces already at the flat address move there once.
